newsitem.title: USA: CorporateFamily sets initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: CorporateFamily sets initial public offering.

text.p: CorporateFamily Solutions Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of its common stock.
The company did not give the terms of the offering.
The deal is expected to make its debut in August, and will be managed by Montgomery Securities and J. C. Bradford & Co, the company said.
CorporateFamily provides management and consulting services for companies seeking to provide employees with workplace child care, education and other family support programs.
According to the filing, the company's proposed stock symbol is "CFAM".
